function: The members defined by this feature are not affected for the specific load case.
menu_path: From the Main Menu select [Load] tab > [Type : Misc.] > [Etc.] group > [Ignore Elements for Load Case]
usage:
Load Case Name : Select load case not to be considered in the analysis.

Options

Add : Add an assignment of the selected members.

Delete : Remove the assignment information of the selected members.
